description.value: Biscuit is a casual supper restaurant and wine bar in Kimberley founded in 2021, committed to locally sourced and premium ingredients with everything made in-house. Run by Ryan, a Southern BC hospitality veteran, it aims for the simplicity of a pub environment paired with fine-dining quality, offering an ever-changing menu for adventurous eaters. The spot also carries a retail selection of specialty ingredients, house-made condiments, and cocktail kits, plus a recurring wine club.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is open at 180 Spokane St, Kimberley BC with phone 1.250.220.1606, both matching OSM tags exactly. The site describes a casual supper restaurant and wine bar with locally sourced ingredients, established in 2021. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists Wednesday–Saturday from 16:30, but the website states 5:00pm (17:00) for those days — a 30-minute discrepancy. OSM may be outdated.
Website copyright reads '© 2021 by Biscuit' and was built on a basic Wix template; content freshness is uncertain, though the business appears operational.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant confirmed open via website with matching address and phone. A useful dinner stop for touring cyclists in Kimberley.
